selected_repairs: Use the Linux joystick ABI directly and nonblocking from the control thread; do not run pygame or a controller polling thread on Linux.
Discard bytes returned after an absolute serial deadline and classify the required state as stale/timeout.
Fail on disconnected or stale physical-controller state even while paused.
Allow runtime_timing_probe to exercise the same physical-controller backend during a torque-off serial run.
